div.p: Side-by-side comparison of the two ways to declare a Qoala program:

ul.li: Left: Decorator pattern. A free function decorated with @QoalaProgram. Arrow into a single QoalaProgram instance with .compile().

Right: Inheritance pattern. class MyProgram(QoalaProgramBase) with a main(self) method. Arrow into a QoalaProgram instance (note: not QoalaProgramBase, due to the __new__ redirection) with .compile().

div.p: Both arrows converge into the same QoalaModule output. Use this figure to make the "they end up at the same place" point visually.
